Mr. P.C. Maulekhi, learned counsel for appellant-Insurance Company.

This is an appeal u/s 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988 assailing the judgment and award dated 03.08.2024 passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/ 1st Additional District Judge,
Haridwar in MACP No.85 of 2022 (Smt. Rekha and others v. Smt. Jyoti Sharma and others),
whereby, the claim petition filed by the respondents- claimants was allowed and a compensation to the tune of Rs.12,01,823/- was awarded to the respondents-claimants along with 6% p.a. simple interest from the date of filing claim petition till the date of actual payment.
4. Admit.
5.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that it was case of head on collision between the truck No.HR 73-0675 insured with the appellant and a Bolero taxi No.UK-08-TA-6175.
6.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the accident occurred at Chandi Ghaat Bridge and the Bolero was very rash and negligent and in that accident, the truck fell into the river in order to avoid the accident.

7. It is also submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that though it was a head on collision between the two vehicles, respondents-claimants had not impleaded the owner/driver of Bolero and its insurer as party respondent in the claim petition.
8. Issue notices to the respondents, returnable within 06 weeks.

9. Steps to be taken within 10 days.

It is provided that during the pendency of the present appeal, the execution of the impugned judgment and award dated 03.08.2024 passed by learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal/1st -Additional District Judge, Haridwar in MACP No.85 of 2022 (Smt. Rekha and others v. Smt. Jyoti Sharma and others), shall remain stayed, provided the appellant deposits a sum of Rs.8,00,000/-
before the learned concerned Claims Tribunal adjusting the statutory deposit, within a period of four weeks from today.
